description: When a note bought at a discount is paid off early, the discount is earned sooner and the yield rises, and this tool computes the yield if the borrower pays off after a chosen number of payments versus holding the note to maturity. Inputs are the price, balance, rate and payment terms you supply. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

balloon.description: Balloon (lump sum) due with the last payment, USD. Default 0.

months.description: Number of monthly payments LEFT (not the original term).

payment.description: Monthly payment in USD. If omitted, computed from balance, rate and months.

payoff_after_payments.description: Number of payments made before the full payoff.

price.description: Price paid for the note, USD.

name: early_payoff_yield
title: Early payoff yield calculator
